comment: Koenigsegg Regera onboard acceleration at Goodwood 2018, by Mr JWW (CC BY 3.0), used with approval as the One:1 stand-in. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Regera_Goodwood_2018.ogg . Convert the original to 44100 Hz mono PCM16 as regera.wav. RPMs are pitch estimates, not measured telemetry; idle and upper revs are pitch-shifted from the available acceleration layers.
